## Spatial predictions of mortality and ATE [GAMs]
#### Create GAM models.
•	Interaction between smoothed (`lon`, `lat`) and factor (`isTreated_child`) variables.
•	ATE: -18.5\% (1-exp(-0.20429))

```{r}

# for help:
# 1. "An introduction to mgcViz: visual tools for GAMs":
#   https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/mgcViz/vignettes/mgcviz.html
# 2. "Plotting differences between two 2D smooth effects":
#   https://mfasiolo.github.io/mgcViz/reference/plotDiff.mgcv.smooth.2D.html

# output is log-transformed IRRs
gammort_1to59_child <- gam(n_deaths_1to59 ~
                             isTreated_child +
                             s(lon,lat, by = isTreated_child) + #confirm bs
                             offset(log(pt_year_1to59)),
                           data=df_all,
                           family = poisson,
                           method = "REML")


gammort_1to59_child_test <- gam(n_deaths_1to59 ~
                                  lon + lat + isTreated_child +
                                  lon*isTreated_child +
                               lat*isTreated_child +
                             s(lon,lat) + #confirm bs
                             offset(log(pt_year_1to59)),
                           data=df_all,
                           family = poisson,
                           method = "REML")

gammort_1to59_child_test2 <- gam(n_deaths_1to59 ~ #no spatial interaction
                             isTreated_child +
                             s(lon,lat) + #confirm bs
                             offset(log(pt_year_1to59)),
                           data=df_all,
                           family = poisson,
                           method = "REML")

summary(gammort_1to59_child)
# coef(gammort_1to59_child)
```

#### Convert predictions into mapping elements.
```{r}
gammort_1to59_child <- getViz(gammort_1to59_child_test)

#plots by treatment arm
plot(sm(gammort_1to59_child_test, 1)) #Control
plot(sm(gammort_1to59_child_test, 2)) #Treated

#ATE
pl <- plotDiff(s1 = sm(gammort_1to59_child, 2), 
               s2 = sm(gammort_1to59_child, 1)
               )
pl

# Plot p-values for ATE
pl + l_pvRaster() + l_pvContour()

```

### Compare models (AIC)
•	GAM fits the data better than spaMM model. 

```{r}
AIC(gammort_1to59_child) #1386.613
AIC(fitmort_1to59_child) #1476.8333-1590.4433
```
